name: Brompheniramine Maleate

fda.text: Do not use ▪ to sedate a child or to make a child sleepy Ask a doctor before use if you have ▪ trouble urinating due to an enlarged prostate gland ▪ glaucoma ▪ a breathing problem such as emphysema, or chronic bronchitis. Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are ▪ taking sedatives or tranquilizers When using…

summary: This medicine must not be used to make a child sleepy or to calm them down [3]. You must speak with a doctor before using it if you have trouble urinating from an enlarged prostate gland, eye pressure problems called glaucoma, or ongoing breathing conditions like emphysema or chronic bronchitis [3]. You should also ask a doctor or pharmacist first if you are currently taking sedatives or tranquilizers, which are drugs that help with sleep or calm you down [3]. Finally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a low score of 11 for liver effects and a medium score of 54 for heart effects [M].
